n: A week of releases, and the quiet word in them was memory. Meta's first frontier model is built to carry what you told it last time, and Google's new Gemini is built to say less and hedge less. When a tool starts remembering you, ask where that memory lives and who can read it; the answer is in the model card, which is why we link one.
